User message with mixed text and image_url content parts to verify multimodal serialization

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:liter_llm/liter_llm.dart';
import 'package:liter_llm/src/liter_llm_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final request = await createChatCompletionRequestFromJson(json: '{"max_tokens":100,"messages":[{"content":[{"text":"What is in this image?","type":"text"},{"image_url":{"detail":"low","url":"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/47/PNG_transparency_demonstration_1.png/280px-PNG_transparency_demonstration_1.png"},"type":"image_url"}],"role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-4o"}');
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.chat(req: request);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
